summary_en: Correction to 31 July 2026 buyback announcement. Treasury share count as of 30 June 2026 revised from 1,051,487 shares to 1,036,787 shares. Ex-treasury issued share count remains 30,896,513 shares.
title_en: Correction to 'Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock'
translation_en_brief: This is a corrective filing to the buyback announcement released on 31 July 2026 at 19:00 JST. The correction pertains solely to the reference information (参考) regarding treasury stock holdings as of 30 June 2026. The number of treasury shares held is revised downward from 1,051,487 shares to 1,036,787 shares. The denominator—issued shares excluding treasury—remains unchanged at 30,896,513 shares. The substantive terms of the original buyback authorization (acquisition limit, price ceiling, execution window, and method) are not specified in this correction notice and are presumed to remain as announced in the original 31 July disclosure. This filing does not itself constitute a new buyback authorization but an administrative clarification of the treasury position on the reference date.
